fields.value: Let a repository share report templates across its experiments

Let a repository share report templates across its experiments

## Problem

Each experiment file writes its own `report()`, and a repository's conventions live in ad hoc modules. manabot's `manabot/training/panels.py` holds the PERF/ML panels; display names, comparison charts and patches live in per-experiment scripts. Etude has no pattern for a repository to declare report templates once and have every experiment inherit them. So each new experiment repeats or forgets that work, and fixes to one report (see EXP-44 and the manabot report-defaults Task) don't carry over to the next.

## Outcome

An Etude pattern, documented and with an example, for a repository to define shared report parts: perf/ML panel sets, standard comparison charts (e.g. a model vs its earlier self, vs a fixed anchor, a head-to-head with one line), job display-name rules, and environment defaults. An experiment's report composes them and overrides only what is specific to it. manabot is the first adopter. Keep the boundary: Etude owns the mechanism and generic chart kinds, and the repository owns its metric keys and conventions. Builds on EXP-44's panel capabilities.
